desc: 白蓝双色商务衬衫套图版式，挺括领型与通勤场景双线叙事
name: 挺括有型商务长袖衬衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的正面主图
一秒传达挺括领型与版型的核心卖点
放大领口软塌起皱的尴尬，反衬挺括领型
代入通勤晨间场景，让买家投射自己的生活
用缝线与织物细节证明做工与面料质感
对比面料拉伸后是否回弹，消除变形疑虑
平铺展示版型并留空尺码表位，消除尺码疑虑
并排展示两个配色让买家快速选择
收口促单，留空按钮位引导行动

style.backgroundSystem: porcelain-mist sweep #EFF3F2 for packshot, spec and variant screens, deep spruce display field #22473E for benefit, macro and closing screens, one extended greige studio wall #E4DED4 reserved for the scene screen
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and blank chip outlines in copper ochre #A65E3F only, all letterless
style.lightingSystem: bright soft cool studio light with a front-left key, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars, 5200K neutral white balance for scene work
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent crisp business menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of porcelain-mist background #EFF3F2, deep spruce display green #22473E, copper ochre accent #A65E3F and ink text #1E2422; bright soft cool studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line letterless icons in copper ochre only; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable squared-collar hero scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no hues beyond #EFF3F2, #22473E, #A65E3F and #1E2422 plus one product-matched greige neutral #E4DED4
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or brush lettering
no random scenic backgrounds or gradient sweeps
no inconsistent lighting or warm cast drift
style.presentationRules: shirt reads as the same crisp garment across the set: buttoned collar squared, stable hero scale, folds neat and symmetrical
style.surfaceSystem: matte porcelain-mist board #EFF3F2 and a smooth deep spruce matte panel #22473E
